# consistency-check — µTest++ Testing Framework

The rules of the `consistency-check` skill that are specific to this
project. This file is owned by the project, and it is never
regenerated; it extends the generated `SKILL.md` in this folder, and
takes precedence over it where they differ.

## Scope

The folders generated by vendor tools, excluded from the check,
include `stm32cubemx/`.
